_about: How to find and fight Forever rares, written by RareNet in its own words from the facts ForeverChanges (foreverchanges.pro) lists for Forever, used with their permission. Shipped by tools/gen_tactics.py ahead of the classic data.
5797: Four elite scouts (level 24 and 25) ride the southern Barrens road together, from Bael Modan north past Camp Taurajo and back. They fight as one: bring a group.
5828: Rests with his pride of lions under the great tree north of Ratchet. His respawn is long (eight to twelve hours in Classic), so take him when he is up.
5831: Roams the plateau north of Ratchet, the same one as Humar the Pridelord.
5931: Walks the Venture Co. camp at Windshear Crag, in the east of Stonetalon Mountains, around 66, 50.
5932: Patrols Windshear Crag in the east of Stonetalon Mountains, around 62, 54, fighting with the very dagger it drops.
5934: A heavy hitter with a poison. Solo kills were a close call even for players a couple of levels above 30 in Classic: bring a second player. It has a single spawn point and took five to eight hours to come back in Classic. Hunters cannot tame it.
214456: Can turn up in three places in the Redridge Mountains: Render's Valley (74, 82), Stonewatch Keep (63, 43) and Render's Camp (36, 9).
248299: Not the grey Matriarch Bristlefur: this one is a black bear, with more health than Hogger (over 800). Find it south of Ridgepoint Tower, where the tower guards lend a hand, or on the calmer hills north of Stone Cairn Lake.
250936: One of its spots is at 56.3, 31.7, on the cliff edge to the left of the central structure. Its loot so far: an ordinary green.
255699: A dungeon rare, not there on every run. It walks the north-west of the dungeon with Skeletal Soldiers and has about 2,600 health.
259388: An owlbear of the Shadowgale Forest with a 1.6 attack speed.
259394: Loops around the giant tree beyond the Hippogryph Protectors in Thendal Grove. Hunters cannot tame it.
270294: An elemental with about 2,400 health whose frostbolts hit for over 100. It drops the Clouded Water Globe, which starts a quest. A strong player can solo him around level 20, but a group is safer.
270589: Night only (server time, usually after 9 pm): it rises out of the sea on the west coast and follows the main river up to the dam, where it disappears. Up to three can roam at once, each back 5 to 30 minutes after a kill. Slows work on it, so it can be kited.
274300: A blue ghost wolf of the Whispering Forest that uses Furious Howl. Its respawn takes hours.
276089: Wanders the bottom of Brightwater Lake. So far it dropped only linen cloth and copper.
276101: Look by the road opposite the leatherworking trainer. Back one to two hours after a kill.
276111: Seen at four spots behind the big trees on the hills by the tunnel to the Wetlands. Respawns in about 30 minutes. No loot of its own so far.
